code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There is also increased red cell distribution width and mild monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. These findings may indicate bone marrow dysfunction or suppression, possible hypoxic injury, and impaired renal function. Urgent clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended.
